L131-141 filtered.length>0 ? DataTable: same props preserved — tableId='audit-logs', columns, data=filtered, keyExtractor=log=>String(log.id), compact, exportable, exportFilename='audit-logs', pagination={defaultPageSize:50}. Native pagination slices data to 50/page exactly like the web data.slice((page-1)*size, page*size) and shows a Previous/Next + 'Showing from–to of total' pager only when totalPages>1. CSV export mirrors the web DataTable: visible columns mapped to CsvColumn via a shallow row[col.key] accessor (the page passes no exportRow, so the synthetic 'time' column exports empty exactly as on web) over the full filtered data, serialized with a byte-for-byte ported escapeCell/toCSV, then a feature-detected Blob+anchor download with UTF-8 BOM; on bare native it falls back to copying the CSV to the clipboard, then to an explicit 'Unavailable' export state (contract rules 4 & 7).
L142-146 : no-matches branch -> muted caption AppText t('audit.noMatches','No audit entries match your search.').
L148-152 else (no rows) branch -> muted caption AppText t('No audit entries found').
L153-157 closing GlassPanel/FadeIn/PageContainer + component close: structure preserved.

Native-safe browser-only behaviour (contract rules 4,5,7): (a) the CSV export Blob+object-URL+anchor download and navigator.clipboard fallback are both feature-detected, with an explicit 'Unavailable' state instead of a silent failure; (b) document.title writes are feature-detected. No DOM-only modules, HTML elements, react-i18next, lucide-react, Recharts, Leaflet, or web UI components are imported — only react, react-native primitives (View/ScrollView/Pressable/TextInput/Animated/StyleSheet/Platform), the ported native useAuditLogs hook, and the existing apps/native SemanticIcon/AppText/GlassPanel + theme tokens.

Gates run from apps/native: `npm run typecheck` (tsc --noEmit), `npm run lint -- --quiet`, and `npm test -- --runInBand --detectOpenHandles` all pass. The new page is self-contained and imported by no existing test, so the suite is unaffected.
